_comment: Interactives that only say something in the chat when pressed (Managers/InteractiveMessages.cs).
Measured on the official server: the element in use, then an information message (type 0)
with its id; toMap/toCell, a map change after it; opens, another element of the map opened
and the cells it stood in the way of freed. A quest that has the element among its
objectives takes the click first; this is what it does otherwise.
gives: items put in the bag (each only while none is carried), when criterion (an item
criterion, ItemCriteria) holds; refused otherwise, as a passage's criterion is.
Source: official server packet captures, 2026-11-17 to 11-21.

Dramak's Theatre, third room: lever 5 of 5 (green, bottom right, cell 458). Pulled last after the other four in order it opens the arch at the back of the stage, 482983 on cell 299, whose floor leads backstage (floor_passages.json). Dofus pour les noobs, «Théâtre de Dramak»: red, purple, orange, yellow, green. The arch's open state is not measured; 1 as the other levers'.

Kanniball Village - Exit [29,9]: the urn at the back of the room, left of the throne (cell 191, graphic 34898), hands the Kannibubble Scroll (27416), which teaches the common spell Kannibubble (24015). Dofus pour les noobs, «Village Kanniboul»: «Il faut commencer par vaincre le Boss», then «cliquer sur l'urne au fond de la map à gauche du Trône»; the scroll is bound to the character. The winners only reach this room past Kanniball Andchain, so the boss is beaten by being here. The criterion is the scroll's own (PT!24015&PT!24016): not to a character who already knows the spell, and not a second one while one is carried. Neither the urn's skill nor whether a run gives more than one scroll is measured: «Usar» 184 as the other urns and statues here.
